subject: 4054 Mystic Valley Parkway Life Science Project
overview: The board reviewed updated site plans and transit mitigation strategies for a proposed life science development at 4054 Mystic Valley Parkway. Members also discussed internal board regulations and received administrative updates regarding new applications and public ways.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the minutes for the meeting of November 18, 2021.

items.title: Site Plan Review: 4054 Mystic Valley Parkway
items.summary: Project proponents presented revised designs for the 'Rise Together' life science project, detailing facade transparency, carbon reduction goals, and transportation demand management programs. The board continued the matter to June 22 to address specific concerns regarding site grading and a proposed seven-and-a-half-foot retaining wall near the wetlands.

items.title: Board Rules and Regulations
items.summary: Continued the review of board rules and regulations to the next meeting to allow for further alignment with new zoning requirements.

items.title: Miscellaneous and Other Updates
items.summary: Staff provided updates on public way acceptances for Freedom Way and Steve Miller Drive, introduced four new department interns, and announced a new site plan application for a cannabis dispensary at 162 Mystic Avenue.
